subject: Airport layover & driver credentialing — workshop week logistics
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Pacific Car Rental <ops@pacificcarrental.com>, Hilton SF Events <events@hiltonsf.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Airport layover & driver credentialing — workshop week logistics

Hi team,

We’re finalizing ground logistics for the Acme on-site workshop (June 14–16). A couple of items to confirm so doors / secure zones go smoothly during arrival windows:

1) Driver credentialing: Acme requires on-site drivers to present company-issued IDs and vendor credentials (badge or letter). We will provide a credential template (attached) that drivers can print and have signed at the Hilton security desk. Can Pacific confirm whether your drivers can carry a printed copy + QR badge we can pre-generate?

2) Layover vehicle plan: Several execs have long layovers and will need a short-term vehicle/driver hold between arrival and check-in (up to 3 hours). We prefer a waiting area near the terminal curb (not valet) with a single point-of-contact to minimize phone tag. Can you assign a dispatcher name and mobile?

3) Parking permit: The Hilton campus needs a temporary lot permit for reserved guest vans. I attached the permit form — can you complete and return so I can submit to the hotel?

4) Emergency contact & key handoff: If drivers are switching mid-shift, please include the spare-key protocol and a 24/7 emergency number for our on-call ops lead (Marcus).

Timelines: we need driver credential list and dispatcher contact by EOD Wednesday (Jun 2) to complete hotel approvals.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

—
Naomi Feldman
Enterprise Events & Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

Attachments: 2027-06-01_driver-credential-template.pdf, parking-permit-form-fillable.pdf
From: Pacific Car Rental <ops@pacificcarrental.com>

Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Airport layover & driver credentialing — workshop week logistics

Hi Naomi / team,

Thanks — we can support. Quick answers below and a couple of clarifying Qs.

- Driver credentials: We will issue printed vendor letters plus a QR verification badge that guests can scan to confirm assignment. We can populate the attached template with driver names and license numbers.
- Dispatcher contact: Primary dispatcher is Luis Ortega (cell +1 510-555-0799). He will monitor arrivals and coordinate curb staging.
- Layover holding: We can provide hold service up to 3 hours per vehicle; drivers will remain with the vehicle unless instructed to stage at an off-airport lot.
- Parking permit: We can fill and return the hotel permit; however, the Hilton requires vehicle plate numbers to issue a pass. Please advise when you have final van plate list.
- Spare keys/emergency: We use sealed key pouches tracked via timestamped handoffs; we will provide the pouch protocol in the next message.

Clarifying Qs: 1) Can you confirm the preferred pickup curb name (International Arrivals vs. Terminal 1 curb)? 2) Are any ADA-accessible vehicles required?

I’ll attach the driver roster draft by EOD.

Best,
Rosa (on behalf of Pacific Ops)
Pacific Car Rental
ops@pacificcarrental.com | +1 (510) 555-0799

Attachment: draft-driver-roster.csv

Follow-up with the spare-key pouch protocol and dispatcher confirmation: 

- Key pouch protocol: Drivers will present original company ID and driver license at Hilton security; security will sign the pouch receipt and timestamp. We seal the pouch after both signatures; pouch contains 1 spare key and a manifest card. Pouches are tracked in our dispatch system and recorded to the booking ID (ACME-WKSP-221).
- Dispatcher: Luis Ortega (ID 942) will be on shift for the June 14 arrivals; backup dispatcher is Priya Shah (cell +1 510-555-0933).
- Curb preference: We will stage at Terminal 1 curb for international arrivals unless Hilton advises otherwise.
- ADA: We will reserve one wheelchair-accessible van and confirm plate number by EOD Wed (Jun 2).

Attaching draft roster and a DOCU-SIGN link to authorize access to driver license details (Rosa will send link to Sarah at Acme).
